title: Essentials
description: Configure settings for your generated canvas app.

fields.label: Canvas ID
fields.description: Use 1–100 characters: lowercase letters (a–z), numbers (0–9), and hyphens (-). Start with a letter or number. Reserved IDs, including Windows device names like con and com1, cannot be used.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Enter a title of 1–120 characters for your canvas.
